profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Starfish Storage

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: America’s Test Kitchen is a real 2,500 square foot test kitchen located in Brookline Village. We have two TV shows and publish recipes, equipment ratings, taste test results, and kitchen tips across a wide variety of websites, magazines, and cookbooks. The engineering team at America’s Test Kitchen(ATK) is responsible for maintaining and extending our two major platforms (affectionately known as Everest and School) that provide the web experiences across our four primary web properties.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Principal Engineer on the team building the next generation e-Commerce system.

positions.title: Platform Integration Tech Director
positions.description: Leading an engineering and QA team responsible for integrating and support the WB Games Online Platform within all the game studios.
